title: Climbing & Bouldering Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Kaya sessions (`kaya:session`), MoonBoard sessions (`moonboard:session`), Tension Board sessions (`tensionboard:session`), 8a.nu sends (`eighta:send`), hangboard protocols (`hangboard:protocol`).
app: Kaya app sessions, MoonBoard and Tension Board logs, 8a.nu send history, and hangboard protocol trackers streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=kaya:session) OR (index=personal sourcetype=moonboard:session)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="kaya:session","primary",sourcetype="moonboard:session","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from kaya:session and moonboard:session to see whether two climbing feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `kaya:session` and `moonboard:session` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main climbing data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
